blurb.en: Listen to two friends chatting, and find their feelings, reasons and choices.
blurb.vi: Nghe hai bạn trò chuyện, rồi tìm cảm xúc, lý do và lựa chọn của các bạn ấy.

favourite.def: The one you like more than all the others.

the best part.def: The bit of something that you liked the most.
the best part.ex: *The best part* of the trip was the boat ride.

prefer.def: To like one thing more than another thing.
prefer.ex: I *prefer* milk chocolate to dark chocolate.

agree.def: To think the same as another person.
agree.ex: My friend says the song is great, and I *agree*.

excited.def: Very happy because something good is going to happen.
excited.ex: I'm so *excited* about the trip tomorrow!

worried.def: Feeling that something bad might happen.
worried.ex: She is *worried* about the long walk.

proud.def: Happy because you did something well.
proud.ex: I felt *proud* when I finished the race.

bored.def: Not interested, because nothing fun is happening.
bored.ex: The film was very long, and I was *bored*.

nervous.def: A little scared before something important.

usually.def: On most days, but not every time.
usually.ex: I *usually* walk to school, but today Dad is driving me.

change your mind.def: To make a new choice that is different from your first choice.
change your mind.ex: I wanted the red bag, but then I *changed my mind*.

guess.def: To give an answer when you are not sure it is right.
guess.ex: Can you *guess* what is in the box?

reason.def: Why something happens, or why someone does something.
reason.ex: The *reason* I'm happy is my new bike.

title.en: All three are in the talk
title.vi: Cả ba đều có trong bài nghe

scenes.head: Listen to Clara and Dan.
scenes.html:
Clara: What did you buy at the school fair, Dan?
Dan: Well, I looked at the *books* first, but they were too big for my bag.
Clara: Did you get a cake?
Dan: *No*, the *cakes* were all gone! *So* I bought a *small plant* for my mum.

audio.head: Listen to Clara and Dan.
lines: What did you buy at the school fair, Dan?
Well, I looked at the books first, but they were too big for my bag.
No, the cakes were all gone! So I bought a small plant for my mum.

steps.en: In Part 2, you hear *all three* options in the talk.
steps.vi: Ở Phần 2, em nghe thấy *cả ba* lựa chọn trong bài nghe.

steps.en: Dan talks about books, cakes and a plant. He only bought one thing.
steps.vi: Dan nói về sách, bánh và một cái cây. Bạn ấy chỉ mua một thứ.

steps.en: Listen for *No* and *So*. The real answer comes after them.
steps.vi: Hãy nghe từ *No* và *So*. Đáp án thật nằm sau chúng.

scenes.head: Listen to Kenji and Vy.
scenes.html:
Kenji: Do you walk to school, Vy?
Vy: *Usually* I go by bike. But *today* it's raining, so my dad is *driving* me.
Kenji: Oh. *I* always take the *bus*.

audio.head: Listen to Kenji and Vy.
lines: Do you walk to school, Vy?
Usually I go by bike. But today it's raining, so my dad is driving me.
Oh. I always take the bus.

steps.en: *Usually* tells you what happens on most days.
steps.vi: *Usually* cho em biết điều xảy ra vào hầu hết các ngày.

steps.en: *Today* tells you what happens this time. Vy is going by car today.
steps.vi: *Today* cho em biết điều xảy ra lần này. Hôm nay Vy đi ô tô.

steps.en: The bus is Kenji's answer, not Vy's. Check WHO is speaking.
steps.vi: Xe buýt là câu trả lời của Kenji, không phải của Vy. Hãy để ý AI đang nói.

title.en: A wrong guess and a changed mind

scenes.head: Listen to Elliot and Aisha.
scenes.html:
Elliot: You look happy, Aisha! Is it your birthday?
Aisha: *No*, my birthday is in May! I'm happy *because* I jumped three metres in the long jump today.
Elliot: Wow! Are you going to try the running race next?
Aisha: *I was going to*. *But now* I want to try *skateboarding*!

audio.head: Listen to Elliot and Aisha.
lines: You look happy, Aisha! Is it your birthday?
No, my birthday is in May! I'm happy because I jumped three metres in the long jump today.
Wow! Are you going to try the running race next?
I was going to. But now I want to try skateboarding!

steps.en: A friend often *guesses*. Elliot guesses a birthday, but Aisha says *No*.
steps.vi: Bạn bè thường *đoán*. Elliot đoán là sinh nhật, nhưng Aisha nói *No*.

steps.en: The reason comes after *because*: the long jump.
steps.vi: Lý do đứng sau *because*: môn nhảy xa.

steps.en: *I was going to* ... *but now* means Aisha *changed her mind*.
steps.vi: *I was going to* ... *but now* nghĩa là Aisha đã *đổi ý*.

end.en: Great listening! You found the real answer, not just the words you heard.
end.vi: Nghe rất tốt! Em đã tìm ra đáp án thật, không chỉ những từ em nghe thấy.

v.q: You will hear Rosa and Huy talking about a walk up a hill. What do they agree about?
opts: The hill was hard to climb.
whys: Rosa thinks the hill was hard, but Huy doesn't agree.
Huy saw lots of mosquitoes, but Rosa didn't see any.
v.hint: Listen for *yes* and *I don't agree*. Find the thing they BOTH think.
v.worked: Rosa says the sunset was beautiful, and Huy says "*Yes, it was amazing*."

stim.head: Listen to Rosa and Huy.
lines: Wasn't the sunset beautiful last night, Huy?
Yes, it was amazing. All orange and pink! I took lots of photos.
But the hill was too hard to climb. My legs still hurt!
I don't agree. It was easy! But there were lots of mosquitoes. Look at my arms!
Were there? I didn't see any. Maybe they only like you!

v.q: You will hear Kenji and Aisha talking about a clean-up day. What do they agree about?
whys: Kenji thinks it was hard work, but Aisha says *not really*.
Kenji thinks they started too early, but Aisha didn't mind.
v.hint: Listen for *I agree*. What did the other person say just before it?
v.worked: Aisha says it was fun, and Kenji says "*I agree*. It was great fun."

stim.head: Listen to Kenji and Aisha.
lines: The clean-up was hard work, wasn't it, Aisha?
Not really. It was quite easy. But it was fun to work with all our neighbours.
I agree. It was great fun. But we started too early. Eight o'clock on a Saturday!
I didn't mind that. I always get up early.
Well, next time I want to start at ten!

v.q: You will hear Dan and Vy talking about a book. Why is Vy reading it?
opts: She wants to be an astronaut.
whys: Dan asks about homework, but Vy says the homework is about the moon.
Dan asks this, but Vy says she wants to be a vet.
v.hint: The question asks *why*. Listen for *because*.
v.worked: Vy says "I'm reading it *because we're going camping next week*."

stim.head: Listen to Dan and Vy.
lines: What are you reading, Vy? A book about stars?
Yes. It's about constellations, the pictures that stars make.
No, our homework is about the moon. I'm reading it because we're going camping next week. Dad says we can see lots of stars there.
Cool. Do you want to be an astronaut?
No, I want to be a vet!

v.q: You will hear Clara and Huy talking about the library. Why is Huy going there on Saturday?
opts: to go to a story club
whys: There is a story club, but Huy says it's for little children.
Clara guesses the computers, but Huy has one at home.
v.hint: Clara guesses twice. Listen for *because* in Huy's answer.
v.worked: Huy says "I'm going *because there's a robot show*."

stim.head: Listen to Clara and Huy.
lines: What are you doing at the library on Saturday, Huy? Is there a story club?
There is, but it's for little children. I'm going because there's a robot show. You can make your own robot!
Oh, I thought you wanted to use the computers.
No, we've got a computer at home. Do you want to come?

title.vi: Phần 2: lựa chọn và đổi ý

v.q: You will hear Eva and Elliot talking about a pet. Which pet is Elliot going to get?
whys: Elliot wanted a dog, but his home is too small.
Elliot's mum says a cat is too much work.
v.hint: Elliot talks about what he wanted first. Listen for what he is *really* getting.
v.worked: Elliot says "*Two goldfish!*"

stim.head: Listen to Eva and Elliot.
lines: Are you getting a pet, Elliot? A dog?
I wanted a dog. But our home is too small. And Mum says a cat is too much work.
Two goldfish! We're going to buy a big tank for them on Saturday.
Lovely! Fish are easy to look after. What colour are they?

v.q: You will hear Dan and Rosa talking about a birthday present. What is Rosa going to buy for her mum?
whys: Rosa was going to buy flowers, but she changed her mind after Dan spoke.
Dan says chocolate, but Rosa's mum doesn't eat it.
v.hint: Rosa's first idea changes. Listen for *I'll* near the end.
v.worked: Rosa says "you're right about flowers... *I'll buy her a plant*."

stim.head: Listen to Dan and Rosa.
lines: What are you getting your mum for her birthday, Rosa?
I was going to buy her some flowers. She loves yellow ones.
Flowers? My mum says they die too fast. What about some chocolate?
Mum doesn't eat chocolate. But you're right about flowers. I know! I'll buy her a plant. It lives for a long time.

v.q: You will hear Kenji and Pia talking about the weather. Which weather does Pia like best?
whys: Kenji loves hot, sunny days. Pia doesn't like it when it's hot and humid.
Pia has never seen snow, so it can't be her favourite.
v.hint: Kenji talks about what HE likes. Listen for Pia's *favourite*.
v.worked: Pia says "*My favourite weather is cool and windy*."

stim.head: Listen to Kenji and Pia.
lines: I love hot, sunny days. What about you, Pia?
Hot days are OK, but I don't like it when it's humid. I feel so sticky!
Do you like snow? It's freezing, but it's fun.
I've never seen snow! My favourite weather is cool and windy. Then I can fly my kite.

v.q: You will hear Eva and Huy talking about chocolate. Which chocolate does Huy prefer?
whys: Huy says dark chocolate is too bitter for him. Eva is the one who loves it.
Huy says white chocolate is too sweet.
v.hint: Listen for *I prefer*.
v.worked: Huy says "*I prefer milk chocolate*. It's sweeter."

stim.head: Listen to Eva and Huy.
lines: Try this chocolate, Huy. It's dark chocolate from the new shop.
Thanks. Hmm, it's too bitter for me. I prefer milk chocolate. It's sweeter and softer.
Really? I love dark chocolate! It's my favourite. What about white chocolate?
White chocolate is too sweet. I can't eat much of it.
OK, more dark chocolate for me, then!

v.q: You will hear Elliot and Aisha talking about after school. What will Aisha do today?
whys: Aisha would love to play in the park, but she can't today.
Aisha and her grandma went shopping yesterday, not today.
v.hint: The question is about *today*. Which things can't happen today, or happened on another day?
v.worked: Aisha says "*Today we're making mango jam*."

stim.head: Listen to Elliot and Aisha.
lines: Do you want to play in the park after school, Aisha?
I'd love to, but I can't today. I have to help my grandma at her house.
Are you going shopping with her?
No, we went shopping yesterday. Today we're making mango jam. It takes two hours!
Mmm! Can I try some tomorrow? I love mangoes.

v.q: You will hear Clara and Kenji talking about the holiday. What is Kenji going to do?
whys: Kenji visited his cousins last holiday, not this one.
Clara is going to stay at home and read, not Kenji.
v.hint: Listen for *last holiday* and *this time*.
v.worked: Kenji says "*This time we're going on a trek* in the mountains!"

stim.head: Listen to Clara and Kenji.
lines: Are you going to visit your cousins in the holiday, Kenji?
We visited them last holiday. This time we're going on a trek in the mountains!
Wow! I'm going to stay at home and read lots of books.
That sounds nice too. But I want an adventure! We're going to sleep in a tent for three nights.

items.en: In Part 2, *all three* options are usually said in the talk. Don't choose an answer just because you hear it.
items.vi: Ở Phần 2, *cả ba* lựa chọn thường đều được nói trong bài. Đừng chọn một đáp án chỉ vì em nghe thấy nó.
example: Question: What did Dan buy? (books / a cake / a plant)
Dan: The books were too big. The cakes were gone. *So I bought a plant.*

items.en: A friend often *guesses* first. Listen to the answer after *No*.
items.vi: Bạn bè thường *đoán* trước. Hãy nghe câu trả lời sau từ *No*.
example: Is it a cake? *No*, it's a plant pot.

items.en: *Usually*, *last week* and *last year* tell you about another time. Listen for *today*, *this week* or *this year*.
items.vi: *Usually*, *last week* và *last year* nói về lúc khác. Hãy nghe *today*, *this week* hoặc *this year*.
example: I *usually* have rice, but *today* I've got noodles.
We went to the beach *last year*. *This year* we're going to the mountains.

items.en: People *change their mind*. Listen for *I was going to* or *I wanted to*, then *but* and *so*.
items.vi: Mọi người hay *đổi ý*. Hãy nghe *I was going to* hoặc *I wanted to*, rồi đến *but* và *so*.
example: *I was going to* buy flowers. *But* they die too fast. I'll buy a plant.
*I wanted* orange juice, *but* they haven't got any. *So* I'm having a milkshake.

items.en: Learn the opinion words: *favourite*, *the best part*, *I prefer*, *I agree*, *you're right*, *I don't agree*.
items.vi: Hãy học các từ chỉ ý kiến: *favourite*, *the best part*, *I prefer*, *I agree*, *you're right*, *I don't agree*.
example: *I prefer* milk chocolate. (= I like it more)
*I don't agree*. It was easy! (= I think something different)

items.en: The options may use *different words* from the talk. Match the *meaning*, and check *who* is speaking.
items.vi: Các lựa chọn có thể dùng *từ khác* với bài nghe. Hãy chọn theo *ý nghĩa*, và để ý *ai* đang nói.
example: Talk: *We slept in a tent.* Option: *camping*

check.sentence: In Part 2, the wrong options are {usually|never|not} said in the talk.
"Is it a cake?" "{No|Yes|Maybe}, it's a plant pot."
I {usually|today|yesterday} walk to school, but today Dad is driving me.
I was going to buy flowers, {but|because|and} I changed my mind.
"It was fun!" "I {agree|prefer|guess}. It was great fun."

v.q: You will hear Dan and Vy talking about a treasure hunt. Where did Vy find the treasure?
whys: Vy looked in the sandpit first, but the treasure wasn't there.
Dan guesses the slide, but Vy says no.
v.hint: Vy says *No* twice. Listen for the place she gives after that.
v.worked: Vy says "*It was behind the swings!*"

stim.head: Listen to Dan and Vy.
lines: Well done, Vy! You won the treasure hunt! Was the treasure in the sandpit?
No. I looked in the sandpit first, but it wasn't there.
No. It was behind the swings! There was a little box with a gold star in it.
Oh! I looked near the slide for ages! Well done.

v.q: You will hear Rosa and Elliot talking about a family day out. Where did Elliot go on Sunday?
whys: Elliot's family wanted to go to the beach, but it was too windy.
They are going to the sports centre next Sunday, not this one.
v.hint: Two places are not right. Listen for *So we went to*.
v.worked: Elliot says "*So we went to a farm*. I fed the goats!"

stim.head: Listen to Rosa and Elliot.
lines: Did you go to the beach on Sunday, Elliot?
No. We wanted to, but it was too windy. So we went to a farm. I fed the goats!
That sounds fun. Did you go to the sports centre after that? There's a rugby match every Sunday.
No, we were too tired. We're going next Sunday. Do you want to come?

v.q: You will hear Kenji and Eva talking about school jobs. Who is Eva helping this week?
whys: Eva helped the librarian last week, not this week.
Kenji is helping the school nurse, not Eva.
v.hint: Listen for *last week* and *this week*.
v.worked: Eva says "*This week I'm helping the caretaker*."

stim.head: Listen to Kenji and Eva.
lines: You've got a school job this week, haven't you, Eva? Are you helping the librarian?
No, I helped her last week. I put all the books away. This week I'm helping the caretaker. We're fixing the classroom chairs!
Cool. I'm helping the school nurse. I tidy her room every morning.

v.q: You will hear Pia and Huy talking about a class trip. When is the trip?
whys: Monday is their sports day, not the trip.
The trip was on Thursday, but the teacher changed it.
v.hint: Three days are said. Listen for *Now*.
v.worked: Huy says "*Now it's on Friday*."

stim.head: Listen to Pia and Huy.
lines: Is the class trip to the music academy on Monday, Huy? I can't remember.
No, it's not on Monday. That's our sports day.
Oh! So is it on Thursday?
Well, it was on Thursday. But the teacher changed it, because the bus wasn't free. Now it's on Friday.
Friday? Great! That's my favourite day of the week.

v.q: You will hear Dan and Clara talking about old boxes. What is Clara making?
whys: Dan guesses a house for her cat, but Clara says no.
Dan made a bird house last year. Clara is making something else.
v.hint: Dan guesses. Listen for what Clara says after *No*.
v.worked: Clara says "*I'm making a robot* for the eco fair."

stim.head: Listen to Dan and Clara.
lines: What are you making with those old boxes, Clara? A house for your cat?
Ha! No. I'm making a robot for the eco fair. It's made of boxes and bottle tops.
Cool! I made a bird house from old boxes last year.
I remember. It was great! Can you help me with the robot's arms?

v.q: You will hear Aisha and Huy talking about the rugby club. What time does it start this week?
whys: The club usually starts at four, but not this week.
Six o'clock is when the club finishes, not when it starts.
v.hint: Listen for *usually* and *this week*. And check: does the question ask about the start or the end?
v.worked: Huy says "*this week it starts at half past four*."

stim.head: Listen to Aisha and Huy.
lines: Huy, does the rugby club start at four o'clock?
It usually starts at four. But this week it starts at half past four, because the coach has a meeting at school.
Oh, OK. And when does it finish?
At six o'clock, like always. Do you want to come and watch?
Yes, maybe! I'll ask my mum.

v.q: You will hear Kenji and Rosa talking about Rosa's weekend. What was the weather like in her grandparents' village?
whys: Kenji guesses it was hot, but Rosa says no.
It was wet in the city, not in the village.
v.hint: Kenji guesses. Then he talks about a different place. Listen to Rosa.
v.worked: Rosa says "*No, it was cool*. We wore jumpers in the evening."

stim.head: Listen to Kenji and Rosa.
lines: How was your weekend, Rosa? Was it hot in your grandparents' village?
No, it was cool! We wore jumpers in the evening, and we sat by the fire.
Here in the city it was wet all weekend. It rained on Saturday and Sunday!
Really? We didn't have any rain at all. It was lovely.

v.q: You will hear Elliot and Vy talking about the night sky. What did Vy see?
whys: Vy went to bed too early, so she didn't see the shooting stars.
Elliot was looking for the star picture, not Vy.
v.hint: Elliot and Vy saw different things. Listen to what Vy saw.
v.worked: Vy says "*I saw lightning*. There was a big storm."

stim.head: Listen to Elliot and Vy.
lines: Vy, did you see the shooting stars last night?
No, I went to bed too early! But I saw lightning. There was a big storm at ten o'clock.
I didn't see that. I was looking for a constellation, the Great Bear.
Yes! It looks like a big spoon. I want to find another one tonight.

v.q: You will hear Dan and Pia talking about a cake sale. How many cakes did Pia sell?
whys: Dan guesses twenty, but Pia says *more than that*.
Pia made thirty cakes, but she didn't sell all of them.
v.hint: Two numbers are close. Listen for the word *sold*.
v.worked: Pia says "I made thirty chocolate cakes... and *I sold twenty-eight*."

stim.head: Listen to Dan and Pia.
lines: How many cakes did you sell at the cake sale, Pia? Twenty?
No, more than that! I made thirty chocolate cakes with my mum, and I sold twenty-eight.
Wow, that's a lot! What happened to the other two?
My little brother ate them! He said they were for the helpers.
Ha! Lucky brother! I only sold ten biscuits.

v.q: You will hear Kenji and Aisha talking about a new building. What is it going to be?
whys: Kenji guesses a hotel, but Aisha says no.
Kenji thought it was a museum, but the museum is next to the river.
v.hint: Kenji guesses twice. Listen to Aisha's answers.
v.worked: Aisha says "My mum says *it's going to be a sports centre*."

stim.head: Listen to Kenji and Aisha.
lines: Have you seen the new building in our street, Aisha? Is it a hotel?
No, it isn't a hotel. My mum says it's going to be a sports centre.
Oh! I thought it was a museum, because it's got a strange round roof.
The museum is next to the river. This one is for sport! I hope it has a climbing wall.

v.q: You will hear Huy and Clara talking about a night market. What did Clara like most?
whys: Clara says the food was nice, but she waited a long time for it.
Clara says the music show was quite good, but it wasn't her favourite.
v.hint: Clara likes all three a little. Which one does she like the MOST?
v.worked: Clara says "*my favourite thing was the lantern stall*."

stim.head: Listen to Huy and Clara.
lines: How was the night market, Clara?
Great! The food was nice, but it was very busy. We waited a long time for our noodles.
Did you see the music show?
Yes, it was quite good. But my favourite thing was the lantern stall. There were hundreds of lanterns in lots of colours!

v.q: You will hear Eva and Dan talking about a famous house. What did Dan enjoy most?
whys: The upside-down rooms were funny, but they made Dan feel a bit sick.
Dan says the gift shop was too expensive.
v.hint: Which place would Dan go back to? Listen to the end of what he says.
v.worked: Dan talks about the maze and says "*I'd go back just for that*."

stim.head: Listen to Eva and Dan.
lines: Dan, you visited the famous upside-down house, didn't you?
Yes! The beds and chairs were on the ceiling. It was funny, but it made me feel a bit sick.
Oh no! Was the gift shop good?
It was too expensive. But the garden had a maze. We got lost for twenty minutes! I'd go back just for that.

v.q: You will hear Kenji and Vy talking about lights at home. Why does Vy turn off the lights?
whys: Kenji guesses money. Vy's dad likes that, but it is not Vy's reason.
Kenji thought her mum told her to, but Vy says no.
v.hint: Kenji guesses two reasons. Listen for Vy's own reason after *I do it*.
v.worked: Vy says "*I do it to help the planet*."

stim.head: Listen to Kenji and Vy.
lines: Why do you always turn off the lights, Vy? To save money?
Well, my dad likes that! But I do it to help the planet. We learned about it at school. Using less energy is good for the Earth.
Oh. I thought your mum told you to do it.
No, she always forgets! I tell her!

v.q: You will hear Elliot and Aisha talking about a poster. Why does Aisha like the long jump champion?
whys: Elliot thinks it's because she's fast. She is fast, but Aisha says *that's not why*.
Elliot likes her red shoes, not Aisha.
v.hint: Listen for *that's not why*. The real reason comes after it.
v.worked: Aisha says she hurt her leg, "and *she didn't stop*. She practised every day."

stim.head: Listen to Elliot and Aisha.
lines: Who's that on your poster, Aisha?
She's a long jump champion. I love her!
Is it because she's very fast?
She is fast, but that's not why. She hurt her leg two years ago, and she didn't stop. She practised every day, and she won again!
Wow. That's amazing. I like her red shoes too.

v.q: You will hear Rosa and Huy talking about a school concert. What do they agree about?
whys: Rosa thinks the hall was too hot, but Huy didn't feel hot.
Huy thinks the concert was too short, but Rosa doesn't agree.
v.hint: Find the idea where one person says something and the other says *I agree*.
v.worked: Huy says "The singing was brilliant", and Rosa says "*I agree*."

stim.head: Listen to Rosa and Huy.
lines: The school concert was great, wasn't it, Huy?
Yes! The singing was brilliant. Everyone sang so well. I loved the last song.
I agree. But the hall was too hot. I wanted to open the windows.
Was it? I didn't feel hot. I thought the concert was too short, though.
Too short? No, it was nearly two hours!

v.q: You will hear Pia and Elliot talking about dragon fruit. What do they agree about?
whys: Pia thinks it is sweet, but Elliot says it hasn't got much taste.
Pia thinks it is expensive, but Elliot says it is cheap at the market.
v.hint: Listen for *You're right*. What did the other person say just before it?
v.worked: Elliot says "it's very juicy", and Pia says "*You're right*. It's so juicy!"

stim.head: Listen to Pia and Elliot.
lines: Have you tried dragon fruit, Elliot? I had some at lunch. I think it's really sweet.
Sweet? No, it hasn't got much taste. But it's very juicy.
You're right. It's so juicy! But it's quite expensive, isn't it?
Not at the market. My grandma buys it there every week. It's cheap!

v.q: You will hear Dan and Eva talking about a community day. What is Eva going to do there?
whys: Eva was going to do face painting, but she changed her mind.
Dan suggests the craft table, but Eva chooses something else.
v.hint: Eva's plan changes. Listen for *I'll* at the end.
v.worked: Eva says "*I'll help at the lemonade stall*."

stim.head: Listen to Dan and Eva.
lines: What are you doing at the community day, Eva? Face painting?
I was going to do face painting. But my friend says it's always really busy.
What about the craft table? You're good at making things.
Hmm, maybe. Oh, I know! I'll help at the lemonade stall. We're raising money for new sports equipment.

v.q: You will hear Kenji and Clara talking about Saturday. How will Clara get to the sports centre?
whys: Clara was going to ride her bike, but Kenji says the roads are busy.
Kenji asks her to take the bus, but Clara says no thanks.
v.hint: Clara changes her plan after Kenji speaks. Then listen to her answer to his next idea.
v.worked: Clara says "Oh, you're right. *Then I'll walk*."

stim.head: Listen to Kenji and Clara.
lines: How are you getting to the sports centre on Saturday, Clara?
I'm going to ride my bike.
Your bike? But the roads near there are very busy on Saturdays.
Oh, you're right. Then I'll walk. It's only twenty minutes.
Why don't you come on the bus with me?

v.q: You will hear Aisha and Huy talking about planets. Which planet does Huy like best?
whys: Aisha loves the planet with rings. Huy says it's pretty, but he prefers another one.
Aisha says Jupiter is the biggest, but Huy says *big isn't everything*.
v.hint: Listen for *I prefer*. Then think: which option means the same?
v.worked: Huy says "*I prefer Mars. It's red*."

stim.head: Listen to Aisha and Huy.
lines: Which planet do you like best, Huy? I love Saturn because of its beautiful rings.
Saturn is pretty. But I prefer Mars. It's red, and one day people might live there!
What about Jupiter? It's the biggest planet of all.
Big isn't everything! Mars is more exciting. I want to visit it one day.

v.q: You will hear Rosa and Dan talking about books. What kind of book does Dan prefer?
whys: Rosa loves dragon stories. Dan says they're only OK.
Dan's brother reads comics. Dan thinks they are a bit silly.
v.hint: Rosa says what SHE likes. Listen for Dan's *I prefer*.
v.worked: Dan says "*I prefer books about real animals*."

stim.head: Listen to Rosa and Dan.
lines: Do you like stories about dragons, Dan? I love them! I've got ten at home.
They're OK. But I prefer books about real animals. I learn so many things, like how fast a cheetah can run.
My brother reads those. I think they're a bit silly.

items: "I prefer tea" means I like tea...
"The best part" is the part you like...
Your favourite is the one you like...
Which word tells you about this time?
"I was going to..." means the plan...
"That's not why" means it's not the...
How many times do you hear each talk?
Wrong options in Part 2 are usually...
"This year" or "last year": which is now?
"It was hard work" means it was...
"It tastes too sweet" means there's too much...
"I'm scared of the waves" means I'm...
"My legs get tired" means walking is...
"So I'm doing that now" gives the...

goals: find the real answer after No, but and so
hear the difference between usually and today, last year and this year
understand opinion and feeling words like prefer, agree, worried and proud
